text.description_html:
Laurey 519, 5 Inch Transitional Cabinet Pull

The Transitional 5 Inch Cabinet Pull will look great in almost any home decor setting. Its sleek style is great for modern kitchen remodels while its mounts give it a classic feel. Transitional Cabinet Hardware makes choosing a cabinet pull easy because no matter how your style might change with time, you can be sure that your kitchen cabinet knobs will look great for years to come. The 5 Inch Transitional Cabinet Pull will come in the finish color you choose and packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Nantucket Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey Transitional Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Steel
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 5"
  • Overall Length: 6-1/2"
  • Width: 1/4"
  • Projection: 1-3/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

Sold Individually
